reason.capacity: FAR {{allowed}} allowed vs ≈{{existing}} built — room for ~{{ratio}}× more buildable area
reason.vacant: Effectively vacant on a buildable site (FAR {{allowed}} allowed)
reason.oz: In a federal Opportunity Zone — capital-gains deferral on reinvested gains
reason.ez: In an Illinois Enterprise Zone — sales-tax and fee relief
reason.distressIncentive: In a QCT/NMTC tract — eligible for distressed-area tax credits
reason.tod: Transit-served dash-3 district — a density bonus is possible with a Type 1 amendment, PD or ARO entitlement; parking relief by right
reason.todPct: Transit-served dash-3 district — a density bonus is possible with a Type 1 amendment, PD or ARO entitlement; parking minimums can drop by up to {{pct}}% by right
reason.todParking: Transit-served — parking minimums can drop by up to {{pct}}%; no density bonus at {{zone}}
reason.todParkingGeneric: Transit-served — parking minimums can be reduced; no density bonus unless the district is dash-3
reason.todPd: Transit-served Planned Development — the PD ordinance governs parking and density
reason.adu: ADU-Allowed RS Area — a coach house or conversion unit is allowed, with this zone's limits
reason.landmark: Landmark designation — the Commission on Chicago Landmarks must approve alteration, demolition or new construction in writing
reason.historic: Historic district — exterior changes are reviewed
reason.flood: FEMA flood zone {{zone}} — flood-resistant construction and insurance
reason.lakefront: Lakefront Protection district — additional review applies
reason.pdOverlay: Planned Development — entitlements governed by the PD ordinance
reason.nearCapacity: Built at or near the as-of-right limit — little added capacity
reason.lowDensityHeadroom: Room to add floor area, but the zone only allows low density
reason.compsPointer: See recent comparable sales for the value range
reason.entitlement: {{name}} — entitlements set by the Planned Development ordinance, not as-of-right rules
reason.insufficient: Parcel identity couldn't be confirmed from the address
reason.cityOwned: City-owned parcel — may be acquirable through the city's land-sale programs (ChiBlockBuilder)
reason.appealUpside: Assessment appeals succeed nearby — {{wins}} recent wins, median −{{pct}}% — a property-tax upside

caveat.unverified: Parcel identity unconfirmed — property and comps figures may be a neighboring parcel. Verify the PIN before relying on them.
caveat.noBldgArea: Existing building size is uncertain, so we didn't estimate how much of the allowed floor area is already used.
caveat.recentlyRezoned: This district was changed by an ordinance dated {{date}}. The City's map can lag a passed amendment by up to 90 days — confirm the current district with the Department of Planning and Development.
caveat.complexBldg: Building area is recorded for a {{n}}-parcel complex ({{sqft}} ft² in total), not for this lot, so existing floor area is unknown.
caveat.fallbackZone: Zoning shown is a category default, not a parcel-specific lookup.
caveat.scofflaw: On the Building Code Scofflaw List — unresolved enforcement against this building; budget for compliance.
caveat.strProhibited: Short-term rentals are prohibited on this block (precinct owner opt-out) — relevant if you're underwriting STR income.
caveat.overlayUnchecked: Landmark, historic-district or planned-development status couldn't be checked today (the City's zoning map didn't answer), so this verdict can't rule out that review.
caveat.passedNotOnMap: A rezoning listing this address passed {{date}} and the City's map hasn't caught up — the district behind this read may be out of date.
caveat.zoningUnchecked: The City's zoning map didn't answer today, so this read can't say what district the parcel is in or what that district allows.
caveat.floodUnchecked: The FEMA flood zone couldn't be checked today (FEMA's flood map didn't answer), so this verdict can't rule out a floodplain constraint.
caveat.landmarkDesignationPassed: A Chicago Landmark designation listing this address passed {{date}} and the City's map doesn't show it for this parcel — a Commission on Chicago Landmarks review may apply that this read can't rule out.
caveat.nominal: The County carries this parcel at a nominal assessment (often a shared common area or the remainder of a divided lot), so no value or tax is shown.
